b: ^Ernesto Bautista: That's close enough. Whatever you want, I haven't got it.

start: ^Ernesto Bautista: Evening. Or morning. Hard to tell in here tonight.

^Security. I've been called in about the systems.

c-0: ^Ernesto Bautista: Then I hope they're paying you nights.
c-1: ^Ernesto Bautista: Fair enough. Nobody's anything tonight.

b: ^Ernesto Bautista: I've nothing to say to you.

s1: ^Pull up a chair, if you're stopping.

c-0: ^Ernesto Bautista: Miles is the job. I'm the porter. Anything that needs carrying, I carry it.
^Ernesto Bautista: Tonight that's samples down to the lab and results back up.

^Ernesto Bautista: Nobody notices the porter, normally. Tonight they're all waiting on me.
c-1: ^Ernesto Bautista: Radio. A ward calls, I go. Then I come back here and wait for the next one.
^Ernesto Bautista: Best seat in the house for waiting, this.
c-2: ^Ernesto Bautista: The wards want nurses tonight, not porters.
^Ernesto Bautista: I carry what they send. Anything more and I'm under Sister's feet.

b: ^Ernesto Bautista: Security had a call out for some visitor. Stood down now.
^Ernesto Bautista: Your lot sorted it, I expect. Paying you nights after all.
^Ernesto Bautista: Fuss over nothing, like I said.
^Ernesto Bautista: Security put a call out for some visitor. That's their department.
